prompt: In the anime style, a village market awakens under the pale blue light of dawn. On the left, a woman in a yellow apron stands beside a wooden cart piled high with red apples. A brown dog sits on the cobblestones next to her, its tail wagging gently. In the center, an old man with a white beard holds a silver coin out toward a boy in a blue cap who reaches eagerly to take it. Behind them, a gray cat perches atop a stack of woven baskets, watching the exchange with narrowed eyes. To the right, a girl in a green dress points at a hanging lantern that sways slightly in the morning breeze. Beside her, a baker in a flour-dusted hat offers a steaming loaf of bread to a customer in a purple cloak. The customer extends a hand to receive the warm bread, their fingers almost touching. Near the edge of the frame, a black chicken pecks at scattered grains near the wheel of the cart. Above the scene, a flock of white doves flies past the tiled roofs, their wings spread wide against the brightening sky. There is no modern technology visible in this rustic setting. There is no rain falling from the clear morning sky. The woman in the yellow apron looks down at the brown dog with a soft smile. The boy in the blue cap looks up at the old man with gratitude. The girl in the green dress stands next to the baker in the flour-dusted hat. The gray cat sits on the woven baskets. The black chicken is positioned near the cart wheel. The white doves are above the roofs. The lantern hangs above the girl. The red apples are on the cart.
